description: Frontend multi-card verdict rendering. Renders one violation card per returned complaint under an 'N violations detected' header, preserving CardTilt/Badge/rose-emerald theming, Noto Nastaliq RTL, per-card Copy-ID and Replay-Voice, with the shared transcript and map shown once. Includes a result normaliser that handles both the new {complaints:[...]} shape and the legacy single-object/process-complaint fallback, plus the new i18n key in both locales. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (consumes the MultiComplaintResponse {submission_id, complaints, primary} shape). Grounded in design.md section 2.6.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. In awaaz_pakistan/src/lib/api.js add `export const normalizeComplaintResult = (data) => {...}` that returns { submissionId, complaints, primary }: when data?.complaints is an array -> { submissionId: data.submission_id ?? null, complaints: data.complaints, primary: data.primary ?? data.complaints[0] ?? null }; otherwise (legacy single object or /api/process-complaint fallback) -> { submissionId: data?.submission_id ?? null, complaints: data ? [data] : [], primary: data ?? null }. Leave submitTextComplaint/submitVoiceComplaint returning { success, data, isDemo } unchanged.

In awaaz_pakistan/src/sections/ReportSection.jsx import normalizeComplaintResult from ../lib/api. In handleSubmit, after `const data = result.data;` compute `const normalized = normalizeComplaintResult(data);` and `setVerdictData(normalized);`, keep `onComplaintSubmitted(data)` passing the raw data. Reset points that call setVerdictData(null) stay as-is.

In ReportSection.jsx change the avatar reaction to multi-item: `const isViolation = normalized.complaints.some(c => (c.percentage_overcharge ?? 0) > 0);` build chips by mapping each complaint to a neutral {text: item_name} chip plus, when percentage_overcharge is truthy, one variance chip (variant 'alert' when that item is a violation else 'success'), cap total chips at 6, call avatarController.setVerdict(isViolation, chips). Speak `normalized.primary.native_response` ONCE with `normalized.primary.detected_language === 'Urdu' ? 'ur-PK' : 'en-US'`.

In ReportSection.jsx define an inner `VerdictCard` component ABOVE ReportSection in the same file that takes `{ complaint, copiedId, onCopyId, t, language, speakText }` and renders today's CardTilt verdict block VERBATIM but reading per-complaint fields (complaint.id, item_name, reported_price, official_price, percentage_overcharge, native_response, detected_language, routing_agency, helpline_reference, needs_review). Preserve: rose/emerald theming driven by `complaint.percentage_overcharge > 0`, the three Badge variants (red/green/neutral), formatPrice/formatVariance, the font-urdu RTL branch when detected_language==='Urdu', the per-card Replay-Voice speakText call, the per-card Copy-ID button, and the needs_review amber notice. Drop the dead `|| ...is_violation` term (rely solely on percentage_overcharge > 0). Do NOT render the transcript or MiniLocationMap inside the card.

In ReportSection.jsx change copiedId state to hold the copied id string: `const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState(null);` and `handleCopyId(id){ navigator.clipboard.writeText(id); setCopiedId(id); setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000); }`. Each VerdictCard shows its checkmark when `copiedId === complaint.id`.

In ReportSection.jsx replace the single verdict render block. Guard: `verdictData && verdictData.complaints.length > 0`. Above the card list, when `verdictData.complaints.length > 1`, render a header using `t.verdict.violationsCount.replaceAll('{count}', String(verdictData.complaints.length))` (replaceAll, not replace). Render the shared transcript ONCE from `verdictData.primary.transcript_raw` in a panel above the cards. Render `verdictData.complaints.map((c) => <VerdictCard key={c.id} complaint={c} copiedId={copiedId} onCopyId={handleCopyId} t={t} language={language} speakText={speakText} />)`. Render MiniLocationMap ONCE after the card list from `verdictData.primary` (lat/lng/location_area/shop_name), guarded by `verdictData.primary?.lat && verdictData.primary?.lng`. For a single complaint the layout must match today (no header, one card).
Update the `useEffect([isRecording, isSubmitting, verdictData])` idle condition and any other `verdictData` reads so they operate on the normalised shape without crashing when complaints is empty.

In awaaz_pakistan/src/i18n/translations.js add `violationsCount` next to `viewOnMap` in BOTH verdict blocks: in the English (en) block `violationsCount: "{count} violations detected from your report",` and in the Urdu (ur) block `violationsCount: "آپ کی اطلاع سے {count} خلاف ورزیاں سامنے آئیں",`. Rename or remove nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: `cd awaaz_pakistan; npm run lint` reports no new errors introduced by api.js, ReportSection.jsx, or translations.js.
`cd awaaz_pakistan; npm run build` completes successfully (Vite production build).
ReportSection resolves t.verdict.violationsCount in both en and ur locales (key present in both verdict blocks).

For a multi-complaint response the section renders one VerdictCard per complaint under an 'N violations detected' header with the transcript and map shown once; for a single complaint the layout matches the pre-change single-card layout.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED on branch polish/final (committed locally, not pushed). `npm run lint` (oxlint): 0 warnings / 0 errors across 45 files. `npm run build` (vite 5.4.21): succeeded, 2546 modules transformed. The 'chunks larger than 1000 kB' notice is pre-existing/informational (vendor-three, index chunk) and unrelated to this change.

=== FILES CHANGED (3) ===
1. awaaz_pakistan/src/lib/api.js — added `export const normalizeComplaintResult(data)` -> { submissionId, complaints, primary }. Accepts the new MultiComplaintResponse ({submission_id, complaints[], primary}) AND the legacy single-object / /api/process-complaint fallback (wraps a bare row as complaints:[data], primary:data; empty when data is null). submitTextComplaint/submitVoiceComplaint still return { success, data, isDemo } unchanged.
2. awaaz_pakistan/src/sections/ReportSection.jsx —
   - Imported normalizeComplaintResult.
   - Added a module-level `VerdictCard` component ABOVE ReportSection: renders today's CardTilt verdict block VERBATIM but per-complaint (id, item_name, reported_price, official_price, percentage_overcharge, native_response, detected_language, routing_agency, helpline_reference, needs_review). Rose/emerald theming + Badge variants + formatPrice/formatVariance + font-urdu RTL + per-card Replay-Voice + per-card Copy-ID + needs_review amber notice all preserved. Dropped the dead `|| ...is_violation` term (now solely `percentage_overcharge > 0`). Transcript and MiniLocationMap are NOT rendered inside the card.
   - handleSubmit: `const normalized = normalizeComplaintResult(data); setVerdictData(normalized);` while `onComplaintSubmitted(data)` still passes the RAW data. Avatar reaction is now multi-item: isViolation = complaints.some(pct>0); chips map each complaint to a neutral item_name chip + (when pct truthy) an alert/success variance chip, capped at 6; speaks `normalized.primary.native_response` ONCE with primary.detected_language.
   - copiedId state is now the copied id string (useState(null)); handleCopyId(id) sets it and clears after 2s; each card shows its check when copiedId === complaint.id.
   - Render block: guarded by `verdictData && verdictData.complaints.length > 0`. 'N violations detected' header via `t.verdict.violationsCount.replaceAll('{count}', String(len))` ONLY when complaints.length > 1. Shared transcript rendered ONCE above the cards from primary.transcript_raw. One <VerdictCard> per complaint keyed by c.id. MiniLocationMap rendered ONCE after the list from primary (guarded by primary?.lat && primary?.lng). Single-complaint layout matches pre-change (no header, one card).
3. awaaz_pakistan/src/i18n/translations.js — added `violationsCount` next to `viewOnMap` in BOTH verdict blocks. EN: '{count} violations detected from your report'. UR: 'آپ کی اطلاع سے {count} خلاف ورزیاں سامنے آئیں'. Nothing else renamed/removed.

=== NOTES FOR CONVERGENCE/MERGE ===
- The useEffect idle guard `!verdictData` still works unchanged: verdictData is a truthy normalised object when set and null on reset; the new render guard additionally checks complaints.length so an empty-complaints normalisation (legacy null data) renders nothing without crashing.
- No change to lint config, no new deps, no reformatting of unrelated files. Depends on FEAT-001's MultiComplaintResponse shape (already landed).
